ambiguities_or_notes: All three page markers, the 19 January theme sentence, numbered items 1-5, both attributed quotations, the italic aphorism, and the concluding two sentences are represented; the exact source SHA-256 matched the mounted audited Russian snapshot.

As elsewhere in the Circle of Reading corpus, the Lao-Tzu and Lamennais passages are translated from Tolstoy's compiled Russian wording rather than replaced by modern published translations of their presumed originals.

The swallow passage preserves Tolstoy's shift into first-person feminine imagery in «первая ли я, или тысячная ласточка» as 'whether I am the first or the thousandth swallow' rather than flattening it into an impersonal maxim.
«В частной и общей жизни» is kept as 'In private and common life'; «будь готов отдать ее» remains the compact 'be ready to give it', with 'it' referring to life as in the source.

In the Lamennais passage, the long accumulation and repeated battle/liberation vocabulary are retained rather than broken into a freer paraphrase. «личность» in item 5 is kept conservatively as 'personality', preserving Tolstoy's distinction between the individual personality and liberation from it. Reverse target-to-source audit found no substantive omission or unsupported addition.
